name: com.muppetsg2.unitynativetooltips
description: Native, operating-system tooltips for Unity apps: Win32 (comctl32), macOS (AppKit), Linux (GTK 3), Android (framework tooltip style), iOS (UIKit popover) and WebGL (browser title attribute). Includes a component for UGUI / physics objects (works with Button - TextMeshPro) and a UI Toolkit manipulator. Customizable via TooltipStyle (font, padding, colors, placement, offset, title, delay) and Unity-style rich text (<b>, <color>, <size>…) with a native-looking custom bubble on macOS and WebGL (on WebGL styled after the user's browser, e.g. Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera GX). The Editor and unsupported platforms use a simple IMGUI fallback.

samples.description: Ready-to-play scene (Demo.unity) with Unity's default controls built from code: Button - TextMeshPro, styled tooltips (TooltipStyle), rich text, native vs rich title + icon, legacy Button, Toggle and Slider, plus the Tooltip.Show() API.
